tests.name: Local Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 package, relocate, verify fingerprint, load native modules and exercise required entry points

reported.evidence: /tmp/insrc-linux-x64-lifecycle-smoke.log lines 29–48. Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 OrbStack guest, translated user space. Packaged at 11f65c779, relocated and measured fingerprint, loaded ten staged native dependencies, verified CLI, daemon and MCP. Actual packaged broker captured and terminated a disposable target and confirmed exit. Actual packaged watchdog reported ready and disarmed, then terminated a blocked disposable parent on deadline and recorded the cause.
